task_name:
A customer has contacted support regarding their streaming subscription I-NETFLIX4K789. They've already submitted a cancellation request on this subscription and made it clear they no longer want to continue with the current setup.
However, they've specifically mentioned they still want premium streaming access through the "Premium Streaming Service - Monthly" option instead. This indicates a plan preference change rather than wanting to leave the service entirely.

verifier_configs.name: Checking if subscription I-NETFLIX4K789 was cancelled
verifier_configs.description: Checking if subscription I-NETFLIX4K789 was cancelled
verifier_configs.sql_query: select count(*) from subscriptions where id ='I-NETFLIX4K789' and  status='CANCELLED'

verifier_configs.name: Verify if new subscription was created under the right plan and pending approval
verifier_configs.description: Verify if new subscription was created under the right plan and pending approval
verifier_configs.sql_query:
SELECT count(*)
FROM subscriptions
WHERE plan_id = 'P-5ML4271244454362WXNWU5NQ'
  AND status = 'APPROVAL_PENDING'
  AND start_time >= DATE('now');
